name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted Acrylic And Wooden Sign With Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from a combination of frosted acrylic and wood for a durable and elegant layered design.
    - Layer 1 is crafted from 3mm frosted acrylic, creating a soft translucent effect.
    - Layer 2 is made from 3mm wood, adding warmth, depth, and a natural decorative touch.
    - Comes with a sturdy 5mm wooden base for stable tabletop display.
    - Smooth surfaces and layered construction give the sign a refined, dimensional appearance.
    - Suitable for long-term display as both a decorative piece and a personalized keepsake.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Sign size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Wooden base size: 4 x 8 in ~ 10.16 x 20.32 cm
    - Wooden base width: 4 in (~ 10.16 cm)
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 – Frosted Acrylic: 1-sided printing
    - Layer 2 – Wooden Layer: 1-sided printing
    - Wooden Base: 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a tabletop decorative sign for home, office, shelf, mantel, or desk display.
    - The layered structure creates a visually appealing 2-layer dimensional effect.
    - The wooden base keeps the sign upright and stable on flat surfaces.
    - Suitable for personalized décor with names, seasonal themes, family artwork, or meaningful messages.
    - Works well as a decorative accent for living rooms, bedrooms, entryways, offices, and holiday displays.
    - Ideal for Christmas décor, family keepsakes, housewarming décor, and personalized room styling.
    - Compact freestanding design makes it easy to place and move when needed.
    - Can be used as both a decorative sign and a sentimental personalized gift item.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Christmas gifts and holiday home décor.
    - A meaningful gift for family members, couples, friends, and loved ones.
    - Great for housewarming gifts, anniversary gifts, and personalized keepsakes.
    - Suitable for seasonal displays and special occasion decorations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom décor with a warm wooden and frosted acrylic combination.
    - A thoughtful gift choice for creating memorable decorative moments at home.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted Acrylic And Wooden Sign With Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
